answer: Reciprocity-weighted attestation scores each peer by what it has attested back, and the credit sits in escrow until finality. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so one proof cannot be replayed across a farm; when a thousand identities vouch only for each other, the weights stay near zero, no pulse of real trade registers, and the comet rush of signups leaves the juniper escrow untouched. The attacker pays for a thousand keys to earn nothing.
